sanskrit: saṃśitaṃ ma idaṃ brahma saṃśitaṃ vīryaṃ mama | saṃśitaṃ kṣatraṃ me jiṣṇu yeṣām asmi purohitaḥ ||
english: Sharpened is this brahman-power of mine, sharpened my heroic might; sharpened is my conquering kṣatra-force — of those for whom I am the purohita.

sanskrit: sam aham eṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ śyāmi sam ojo vīryaṃ balam | vṛścāmi śatrūṇāṃ bāhū saṃ śyāmi svān aham ||
english: I sharpen for them the kingdom, I sharpen vigor, heroic might, and strength; I hew off the arms of the enemies, and I sharpen my own men.

sanskrit: tekṣṇīyāṃsaḥ parśor agnes tīkṣṇatarā uta | indrasya vajrāt tekṣṇiyāṃso yeṣām asmi purohitaḥ ||
english: Sharper than the edge of Agni's axe, and sharper still — sharper than the vajra of Indra are those for whom I am the purohita.

sanskrit: adhas padyantām adhare bhavantu ye na indraṃ maghavānaṃ pṛtanyān | kṣaṇāmi brahmaṇāmitrān un nayāmi svān aham ||
english: May they fall down, may they be brought low, those who assail Indra the bountiful overlord. I wound the enemies with brahman-power; I raise up my own men.

sanskrit: eṣām aham āyudhā saṃ śyāmy eṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ suvīraṃ vardhayāmi | eṣāṃ kṣatram ajaram astu jiṣṇu- -ugram eṣāṃ cittaṃ viśve vantu devāḥ ||
english: I sharpen the weapons of these men; I make their kingdom flourish with good heroes. May their kṣatra-power be ageless and conquering; may all the gods win over their fierce resolve.

sanskrit: abhi preta jayata prasūtāḥ saṃ vaḥ śyāmi nara āyudhāni | tīkṣṇeṣavo baladhanvano hata- -ugrāyudhā abalān ugrabāhavaḥ ||
english: Go forward, conquer, urged onward! I sharpen your weapons, O men. You of sharp arrows and powerful bows — strike down the weaklings; you of fierce weapons and mighty arms!

sanskrit: ihaiva dhruvāṃ ni minomi śālāṃ kṣeme tiṣṭhāti ghṛtam ukṣamāṇā | tāṃ tvā śāle sarvavīrāḥ suvīrā ariṣṭavīrā abhi saṃ carema ||
english: Right here I set firm the house, that it may stand in peace, sprinkled with ghee. O house, may we approach you — all heroes, good heroes, heroes unharmed.

sanskrit: ihaiva dhruvā prati tiṣṭha śāle aśvāvatī gomatī sūnṛtāvatī | ūrjasvatī ghṛtavatī payasvatī uc chrayasva mahate saubhagāya ||
english: Stand firm right here, O house — you who possess horses, who possess cattle, who possess pleasant speech; full of vigor, full of ghee, full of milk — rise up for great good fortune!

sanskrit: dharuṇy asi śāle bṛhacchandāḥ pūtidhānyā | ā tvā vatso mīmayad ā kumāra ā dhenavaḥ sāyam ā syandamānāḥ ||
english: You are a support, O house, of great meter, storing good grain. May the calf low toward you, may the young child, may the milk-cows come streaming in at evening.

sanskrit: imāṃ śālāṃ savitā vāyur agnis tvaṣṭā hotā ni minotu prajānan | ukṣantūdhnā maruto ghṛtena bhago no rājā ni kṛṣiṃ tanotu ||
english: May Savitṛ, Vāyu, Agni, Tvaṣṭṛ, the hotar — knowing it — firmly establish this house. May the Maruts sprinkle it from their udder with ghee; may Bhaga, our king, extend our tillage.

sanskrit: mānasya patnī śaraṇā syonā devī devebhir nimitāsy agre | tṛṇaṃ vasānā sumanā asas tvaṃ rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram ||
english: O wife of Māna, sheltering and pleasant goddess — you were first established by the gods. Clothed in grass, benevolent, may you be; bestow on us, O auspicious one, wealth rich in good heroes.

sanskrit: ā tvā kumāras taruṇa ā vatso jagatā saha | ā tvā pariśrutaḥ kumbha ā dadhnaḥ kalaśy ayat ||
english: Into you may the young boy come, and the calf together with the herd; into you may the jar of fermented grain and the pot of curds flow in.

sanskrit: imam indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ ma imaṃ viśām ekavṛṣaṃ kṛṇu tvam | nir amitrān akṣṇuhy asya sarvāṃs tān randhayāsmā ahamuttareṣu ||
english: Magnify this kṣatriya of mine, O Indra; make him the sole bull of the clans. Drive away all his enemies; subdue them for him in the coming contests.

sanskrit: ayam astu dhanapatir dhanānām ayaṃ viśāṃ viśpatir astu rājā | asminn indra mahi varcāṃsi dhehy avarcasaṃ kṛṇuhi śatrum asya ||
english: May he be the lord of lords of wealth; may he be king, the lord of the clans. Place great splendors in him, O Indra; render his enemy devoid of splendor.

sanskrit: emaṃ bhaja grāme aśveṣu goṣu niṣṭaṃ bhaja yo 'mitro asya | varṣmat kṣatrāṇām ayam astu rājā- -indra śatrūṃ randhaya sarvam asmai ||
english: Allot to him a share in the village, in horses, in cattle; cut off from his share whoever is his enemy. May he be the highest king among the kṣatra-powers; O Indra, subdue all the foes for him.

sanskrit: asmai dyāvāpṛthivī bhūri vāmaṃ saṃ duhātāṃ gharmadughe iva dhenavam | ayaṃ rājā priya indrasya bhūyāt priyo gavām oṣadhīnām utāpām ||
english: May Heaven and Earth milk out abundant treasure for him, like a milk-cow yielding warm milk. May this king be dear to Indra, dear to the cows, to the plants, and to the waters.

sanskrit: yunajmi ta uttarāvantam indraṃ yena jayanti na parājayante | yas tvā karad ekavṛṣaṃ janānām uta rājann uttamaṃ mānavānām ||
english: I yoke for you Indra, who brings victory — by whom they conquer and are never conquered — who shall make you the sole bull of the peoples and the highest of human kings, O king.

sanskrit: uttaras tvam adhare santv anye ye ke ca rājan pratiśatravas te | ekavṛṣa indrasakhā jigīvāṃ chatrūyatām abhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||
english: May you be supreme; may all the others be lower — whoever, O king, are your adversaries. As sole bull, as the companion of Indra, as the victor, trample upon the great deeds of those who would be your enemies.
